simple.meaning: בֹּר (bôr) is a Hebrew word meaning “purity.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֹּר (H1252) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 22:21, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, Job, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֹּר (H1252) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֹּר (H1252) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֹּר (bôr) / H1252 is traced through 2 Samuel 22:21, 2 Samuel 22:25, Job 22:30, Psalms 18:21 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness.

timeline.evidenceText: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness.
Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness,
He will even deliver him who is not innocent.
For I have kept the ways of Yahweh,
With the merciful you will show yourself merciful.
